# Export table of the SD-card apps (#519): what an app's ELF may resolve against the OS. Generated by
# `tools/gen_export_table.py --write` from tools/export_api.txt (the curated app API), tools/export_allow.txt and the
# forbid lines of tools/layers.conf; checked on every build. Changing it needs a LICHEN_API_VERSION bump: major
# when a line is removed or its prototype hash changes, minor when one is added (lichen_api_version.h).
# export<TAB>name<TAB>symbol<TAB>origin (header, or allow)<TAB>hash (normalised prototype; - for libc);
# wrap<TAB>X<TAB>__wrap_X: every -Wl,--wrap=X (informational: a new wrap needs no bump).
